name: Coding Club RVCE
description: The Coding Club at RVCE is a student led coding community focused on bridging the gap between academic theory and practical industry skills. Through hands-on workshops, hackathons, and collaborative projects, the club provides a space for students to build real-world engineering solutions.

events.name: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Protocol
events.detail: Step into the Marvel Universe and put your hacking skills to the test in an action-packed CTF (Capture The Flag) challenge ! Uncover hidden secrets, crack mysterious messages, exploit AI, and piece together the clues to complete your mission across the Marvel Universe!

events.name: The Human Neural Network
events.detail: What if you could become an AI? Step into a living neural network where every person becomes a neuron, every decision becomes a signal, and every mistake teaches the network something new. Work together, make the right connections, and watch an entire room learn, predict, and evolve in real time. You’re not watching the AI. You are the AI.

events.name: Black Box Bazaar
events.detail: DECODE. TRADE. REVEAL.  Every card hides a secret. Crack the pattern, trade your edge, and bluff your way to the top. Solve the mystery or sell the lie. In this bazaar, your brain is your currency.

events.name: The Predictive Engine
events.detail: An ensemble learning model, run live on humans: the room is the model, each cluster is a weak learner, and every round updates who the engine trusts. You are not watching a demo — you are the live model, trained in public on one volunteer’s digital crumbs.
